default_schedule.name: wait_stats
default_schedule.description: Wait statistics from sys.dm_os_wait_stats

default_schedule.name: latch_stats
default_schedule.description: Latch statistics from sys.dm_os_latch_stats

default_schedule.name: spinlock_stats
default_schedule.description: Spinlock statistics from sys.dm_os_spinlock_stats

default_schedule.name: cpu_scheduler_stats
default_schedule.description: CPU scheduler, workload group, NUMA, and OS memory pressure snapshot (not collected on Azure SQL DB)

default_schedule.name: plan_cache_stats
default_schedule.description: Plan cache composition (single-use vs multi-use bloat) from sys.dm_exec_cached_plans

default_schedule.name: query_stats
default_schedule.description: Query statistics from sys.dm_exec_query_stats

default_schedule.name: procedure_stats
default_schedule.description: Stored procedure statistics from sys.dm_exec_procedure_stats

default_schedule.name: query_store
default_schedule.description: Query Store data (top 100 queries per database)

default_schedule.name: query_snapshots
default_schedule.description: Currently running queries snapshot

default_schedule.name: cpu_utilization
default_schedule.description: CPU utilization from ring buffer

default_schedule.name: file_io_stats
default_schedule.description: File I/O statistics from sys.dm_io_virtual_file_stats

default_schedule.name: memory_stats
default_schedule.description: Memory statistics from sys.dm_os_sys_memory and performance counters

default_schedule.name: memory_clerks
default_schedule.description: Memory clerk allocations from sys.dm_os_memory_clerks

default_schedule.name: memory_pressure_events
default_schedule.description: Memory pressure notifications from RING_BUFFER_RESOURCE_MONITOR

default_schedule.name: tempdb_stats
default_schedule.description: tempdb space usage from sys.dm_db_file_space_usage

default_schedule.name: perfmon_stats
default_schedule.description: Key performance counters from sys.dm_os_performance_counters

default_schedule.name: deadlocks
default_schedule.description: Deadlocks from a dedicated PerformanceMonitor_Deadlock XE session (xml_deadlock_report)

default_schedule.name: server_config
default_schedule.description: Server configuration (on-load only)

default_schedule.name: database_config
default_schedule.description: Database configuration (on-load only)

default_schedule.name: database_states
default_schedule.description: Per-database state (sys.databases.state_desc) time series; feeds the baseline-deviation database-state alert (not collected on Azure SQL DB)

default_schedule.name: memory_grant_stats
default_schedule.description: Memory grant statistics from sys.dm_exec_query_memory_grants

default_schedule.name: waiting_tasks
default_schedule.description: Point-in-time waiting tasks from sys.dm_os_waiting_tasks

default_schedule.name: dmv_blocking_snapshot
default_schedule.description: Always-on point-in-time blocking snapshot from DMVs (BPR-independent fallback; works when blocked process threshold is unset, e.g. AWS RDS)

default_schedule.name: blocked_process_report
default_schedule.description: Blocked process reports from XE ring buffer session (opt-out)

default_schedule.name: attention
default_schedule.description: Client attentions (queries a client cancelled or timed out) from this install's own XE session, PerformanceMonitor_Lite_<id>_Attention; feeds the Client Timeouts alert (#5640)

default_schedule.name: long_query_completions
default_schedule.description: Long-running query completions (rpc_completed/sql_batch_completed >= threshold, plus attention/cancels) from this install's own XE ring buffer session. OPT-IN, default OFF: enabling creates the session on monitored servers, disabling drops it unless another registration of this install keeps it (#1496). On Azure SQL Database the session is created in each monitored database.

default_schedule.name: database_scoped_config
default_schedule.description: Database-scoped configurations (on-load only)

default_schedule.name: trace_flags
default_schedule.description: Active trace flags via DBCC TRACESTATUS (on-load only)

default_schedule.name: running_jobs
default_schedule.description: Currently running SQL Agent jobs with duration comparison

default_schedule.name: database_size_stats
default_schedule.description: Database file sizes for growth trending and capacity planning

default_schedule.name: index_object_stats
default_schedule.description: Per-object table/index size, usage, and locking stats for growth, unused-index, and contention analysis (daily collection)

default_schedule.name: server_properties
default_schedule.description: Server edition, licensing, CPU/memory hardware metadata (on-load only)

default_schedule.name: session_stats
default_schedule.description: Per-application session counts from sys.dm_exec_sessions

default_schedule.name: session_summary_stats
default_schedule.description: Server-wide session summary (idle/leak signal): total/running/sleeping/idle-over-30min counts, memory waits, top app/host from sys.dm_exec_sessions + sys.dm_exec_requests

default_schedule.name: system_health_events
default_schedule.description: Raw system_health Extended Events (memory broker/OOM, scheduler monitor, sp_server_diagnostics, severe errors, significant waits) captured as XML for health-parser analysis (not collected on Azure SQL DB)

default_schedule.name: default_trace_events
default_schedule.description: Built-in Default Trace events via sys.fn_trace_gettable: file auto-grow/shrink stalls, severe ErrorLog writes, schema DDL, security audits, and Server Memory Change (not collected on Azure SQL DB)

default_schedule.name: job_history
default_schedule.description: Retained SQL Agent job-run history from msdb.dbo.sysjobhistory (per-step results, retries, durations, failures) deduped on the instance_id high-water mark; up to a year retained for the Job History tab (not collected on Azure SQL DB)

default_schedule.name: agent_status
default_schedule.description: SQL Agent service status (Running/Stopped from sys.dm_server_services) and next scheduled run from msdb; drives the Job History tab header (not collected on Azure SQL DB)

default_schedule.name: ag_replica_states
default_schedule.description: Availability Group replica health (role, operational/connected state, recovery and synchronization health) from sys.dm_hadr_availability_replica_states; zero rows on a server with no AGs (not collected on Azure SQL DB)

default_schedule.name: ag_database_replica_states
default_schedule.description: Availability Group per-database replica health (synchronization state, send/redo queue sizes and rates, secondary lag) from sys.dm_hadr_database_replica_states; zero rows on a server with no AGs (not collected on Azure SQL DB)

default_schedule.name: plan_correction
default_schedule.description: Automatic plan correction: per-database FORCE_LAST_GOOD_PLAN enablement from sys.database_automatic_tuning_options plus the engine's live recommendation set from sys.dm_db_tuning_recommendations, with the regressed query's text resolved through Query Store (SQL Server 2017+ and Azure; Enterprise/Developer edition)

default_schedule.name: pvs_stats
default_schedule.description: Accelerated Database Recovery persistent version store size and cleanup state per database from sys.dm_tran_persistent_version_store_stats, with the aborted-transaction count and the skipped-page counters that say why cleanup is not reclaiming; SQL Server 2019+ only, always collected on Azure SQL DB (ADR is always on there)

default_schedule.name: query_store_health
default_schedule.description: Per-database Query Store health from sys.database_query_store_options: actual vs desired state (the cap-hit READ_ONLY transition and its readonly_reason), current vs max storage, cleanup mode and thresholds, and the runtime-stats interval length; one row per database, OFF recorded explicitly
